title: Hold, Reinstatement and Closure Terms of the Corporate Catering Service Agreement
content:
**Holds.** A credit hold on a Corporate Catering Service Agreement is applied by the system when exposure or arrears cross the limit, and it is lifted only after a review that the desk performs once the balance has been settled or the limit formally raised.

**Which agreements may be worked.** A hold, a reinstatement or a closure is only worked while the agreement stands active, on credit hold or closed, and never while it is still in credit review, where the application is withdrawn instead. The state the agreement stands in is read from the company's own agreement record before any of the three is worked.

**Who may end the agreement.** Only the client may end a catering agreement, and the desk records the request for the client to confirm rather than closing the agreement on their word alone.

**Notice.**

> Notice to end the agreement is the number of calendar days printed against the service level, and orders already accepted for service days inside the notice period are served rather than cancelled.

This clause of the closure terms is **no longer in force**. The notice days printed against each service level remain valid figures.

**Orders still standing.** An agreement is not closed while any order stands accepted and unserved; those orders are served or cancelled on the ordinary cancellation terms first, and the agreement closes once none remain.

**The annual spend commitment.**

> Where the client's annual spend for the agreement year has not reached the minimum printed against the service level, the shortfall is settled on the final invoice rather than waived at closure.

This clause of the closure terms is likewise **no longer in force**. The minimum annual spend printed against each service level remains a valid figure.

**After closure.** A closed agreement keeps its invoices, credits and history, and a client returning later opens a fresh agreement rather than reviving the closed one.

| Agreement stands as | A hold, a reinstatement or a closure is worked |
| --- | --- |
| Active | yes |
| On credit hold | yes |
| Closed | yes |
| Pending credit review | no — the application is withdrawn instead |
